name: TEI failed-request counter
notes: metrics::counter!("te_request_failure", "err" => ...) with err taking values such as "batch_size" and "validation". THE err LABEL IS THE POINT: unlike most engines, TEI separates validation rejections (HTTP 400/413) from server-side failures, so a 4xx storm is distinguishable from a 5xx storm in one series instead of needing the HTTP status metric other engines substitute.
